text:
If you're heading out for sunset, expect a mostly cloudy sky with a decent shot at staying dry, though a stray shower can't be ruled out. Sunset is at 7:23, with a north wind around 10 mph and temperatures easing from the mid 70s. Tonight stays mostly cloudy, with a 30% chance of a shower before 4am and a low near 58. The lake should be manageable, with northwesterly winds 10 knots or less and waves 1 to 2 feet.

Saturday starts partly sunny and cooler, topping out around 74, with a north wind of 8 to 12 mph. Showers become possible after 1pm. The official forecast keeps the odds at 30%, but the European model is noticeably wetter, so I'd bring a rain jacket if you're making afternoon plans. Good evening conditions for a waterfront walk, but keep it local and flexible tomorrow after lunch.
